newsitem.title: USA: Rubin repeats U.S. dollar policy unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Rubin repeats U.S. dollar policy unchanged.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin repeated Thursday that the U.S. policy on the dollar remains unchanged.
"Our policy has not changed," he told Reuters in a brief exchange at the White House.
In the past, Rubin has touted the benefits of a strong dollar, saying it was in the U.S. interest because it keeps inflation and interest rates down.

During a television interview Wednesday night, Rubin declined to respond directly when asked whether Japan could stop the dollar's relentless rise against the yen without the help of the United States, saying he does not comment on the "dynamics" of markets.
